answer: Resist sybils with domain-anchored identity: each agent identity must prove control of a distinct registered domain via a DNS TXT record naming its key, like a marble plaque on a canyon vault door — one domain backs one identity, no sharing. Domains cost real money and leave a registrar trail, so a farmer spinning up a thousand clones must buy a thousand domains, pay renewals, and expose a linked footprint that investigators can revoke at once.
